components.heading: Section 10. [Conditions of franchise.]
components.text: The City agrees that under K.S.A 12-2001 , as amended, and other state and federal laws, this Contract Franchise Ordinance must be competitively neutral and may not be unreasonable or discriminatory to any telecommunications local exchange service provider operating in the City. (Ord. 18947 § 10, 8-14-07.)
